status: Prospective implementation checkpoint after reading v1.5 results, before executing the new candidate algorithms; not external preregistration. Published benchmark test outcomes have already been inspected in previous versions, so all empirical claims remain exploratory.
source: Existing seven immutable ProEval files and hashes in transfer_protocol.json; six binary tasks, DICES excluded from policy tuning/evaluation
split: Keep original train/dev/test group hashes. Split original training 40% representation / 60% risk-table calibration; split original development 60% tuning / 40% independent promotion gate, with group-hashed seed 1601. Original test never selects parameters. Additional seeds 1602 and 1603 are selection-sensitivity analyses, not independent test samples.
information: All methods have the same four archived workers and up to three queries. Polarity preserves yes/no or toxic/non-toxic only for StrategyQA/Jigsaw; other tasks preserve answer equality. Context uses task text through a representation-only fitted ridge head and a two-bin predicted mean-error partition. No current-task gold or unacquired answer is exposed to policies.
context_fit: Prompt head fits only representation records. Median predicted mean-error split is fixed there. Leaf risk distributions fit disjoint calibration records, shrunk toward the calibration global joint distribution. Sparse leaves use the global table.
selection: Family hyperparameters and one challenger are chosen only on tuning data, with deterministic complexity-first tie breaking. An independent paired empirical-Bernstein gate at alpha=0.05 may promote this single challenger over the tuning-selected legacy incumbent. Otherwise use incumbent. Gate may be conservative; no guaranteed improvement or coverage under drift is claimed.
engineering: Compiled policies must match the selected legacy's action/choice behavior on all 52 complete equality patterns. New reusable policy serialization is canonical, pool-version bound, finite and fail-closed. Unknown pool versions, unauthorized queries, invalid probability/risk tables and malformed artifacts fail. No neural inference is required.
inference: 2000 paired exact-question-group bootstraps stratified by dataset, macro averaged, for seed1601. Four planned contrasts: polarity-vs-legacy, context-polarity-vs-legacy, tuning-selected-vs-legacy, guarded-selected-vs-legacy. Report ordinary 95% and Bonferroni-style 98.75% intervals. Seed1602/1603 reported separately.
runtime: Microbenchmark legacy versus compiled, interleaved order, same process and inputs, warmup excluded; include median and p95, construction costs and serialized size. No invented LLM latency/dollars. A separate repeated process must reproduce scientific outputs.
limits: Repeated test use limits confirmatory inference
CPU acceleration is implementation improvement, not reasoning superiority
